mapper.select: SELECT s.WH_CD, s.ITEM_CD, s.LOC_CD, s.QTY, i.ITEM_NM, w.WH_NM FROM STOCK s JOIN ITEM_MST i ON s.ITEM_CD = i.ITEM_CD JOIN WAREHOUSE w ON s.WH_CD = w.WH_CD ORDER BY s.WH_CD, s.ITEM_CD, s.LOC_CD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO STOCK (WH_CD, ITEM_CD, LOC_CD, QTY) VALUES (#{whCd}, #{itemCd}, #{locCd}, #{qty}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE QTY = QTY + VALUES(QTY)
